title: ItemHolograms
description: This is a plugin that attempts to reduce the impact of items on your server on server performance.
body:
What is ItemHolograms?

ItemHolograms clear items located on your server at specified intervals. Item information is displayed via a hologram.

-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

⚙️ FULLY CUSTOMIZABLE CONFIG
You can easily change the hologram format, colors, and stacking settings in the config.yml file.
________________________________________________________________________________

✨ FEATURES
Smart Stacking: Items automatically stack up to 96!
Performance: High FPS, zero-lag design.
Commands: /ih reload, /itemholograms reload
________________________________________________________________________________
